title: fix(plugin-view): hand ObjectGallery the gallery block nested, so coverFit, cardSize and visibleFields take effect (objectui#12053)
body:
Fixes #12053

Clause-②: no

Implemented by the os-dev dispatched from seat `domain:ui#3`, session `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, on the claim in comment `6086543001`.

## What changed

`generateViewSchema`'s gallery branch (`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`) now hands `ObjectGallery` the gallery block **nested**, as the node's own `gallery`. That is the shape `ListView` already hands the same renderer. Before, the branch built a flat node that carried `imageField` (from `coverField`) and `titleField` only, so a gallery view handed to plugin-view's `ObjectView` lost `coverFit`, `cardSize` and `visibleFields`. That held for the host `views` prop and for a named `listViews` entry alike.

- The keys are picked **by name** through a new module-local table, `GALLERY_CONFIG_SPELLING`, with the existing `pickFlatMapConfig` helper. The gantt and timeline branches already use this mechanism (objectui#6152 round 14). The table is a `satisfies Record` keyed by every `keyof` of the spec's gallery block (`SpecListView['gallery']`), so a key the spec adds or drops fails `tsc` here. ⛔ No raw spread: an undeclared key in the authored block does not reach the node, and a block key named like a node key cannot override the node's own value.
- **One spelling per key.** The flat `imageField` and `titleField` are gone from the node, because `ObjectGallery` reads the nested `coverField` and `titleField` ahead of them (measured below). The branch's existing `'name'` title floor moves into the block with the key it floors, so an undeclared title still resolves to `name`.
- `ObjectGallery`, `ListView` and every other branch of `generateViewSchema` are untouched. No export, prop, type member or language-pack key changes. `GALLERY_CONFIG_SPELLING` is not exported.

## Dispatch zone 2: the three hypotheses, measured

1. **What `ObjectGallery` reads, and in what order.** These are the read points in `packages/plugin-list/src/ObjectGallery.tsx`, in the block under the comment `Resolve GalleryConfig with backwards-compatible fallbacks`:
   - `coverField`: `gallery?.coverField ?? schema.imageField ?? 'image'` (nested first)
   - `coverFit`: `gallery?.coverFit ?? 'cover'` (nested only)
   - `cardSize`: `gallery?.cardSize ?? 'medium'` (nested only)
   - `titleField`: `gallery?.titleField ?? schema.titleField` (nested first)
   - `visibleFields`: `gallery?.visibleFields` (nested only)

   ⇒ once the block is nested, the flat pair can only restate a nested value, so it is dropped (one spelling per key).
2. **The declared set.** `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0, as plugin-view resolves it, declares `GalleryConfigSchema` (strict) as `ListViewShapeSchema.gallery`. That shape feeds `ListViewSchema` and the named-view `ObjectListViewSchema`. Its keys are `coverField`, `coverFit`, `cardSize`, `titleField` and `visibleFields`. `ObjectGallery` reads exactly these five off `schema.gallery`. No key is on one side only, so this is not a stop. The objectui node type `ObjectGallerySchema.gallery` is typed as the spec's `GalleryConfig`.
3. **Named `listViews`.** `canonicalViewKindBlocks.gallery` folds a named view's `gallery` into the same `viewOptions.gallery` the host `views` entry feeds, so both reach the same branch. Pinned: every route pin in the new test file runs on both routes.

## End-to-end reading through the real `ObjectGallery`

This is a scratch probe and is not committed. It uses the real `SchemaRenderer`, imports `@object-ui/plugin-list` (through the root vitest alias) for its `object-gallery` registration, and mounts plugin-view's `ObjectView` with the gallery block `{ coverField: 'photo', coverFit: 'contain', cardSize: 'small', visibleFields: ['stage'] }` and one row that carries a cover URL.

| route | before: the flat node (ablation A1 below) | after: HEAD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| host `views` prop | `object-cover` img, medium grid (`lg:grid-cols-4`), no `stage` on the card | `object-contain` img, small grid (`xl:grid-cols-6`), `stage` value shown |
| named `listViews` entry | same as the row above | same as the row above |

**Why the probe is not committed:** plugin-view does not depend on `@object-ui/plugin-list`, and its type-checked test program (`tsconfig.test.json`, `paths: {}`) cannot resolve that package. The committed pins read the generated node at the `SchemaRenderer` seam, as every sibling file in this package does. The app-shell import-side run below does reach the real `ObjectGallery` through this branch, with no gallery block.

## Tests

- **New:** `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.galleryBlockNested-12053.test.tsx`. It holds triage's pins (comment `6080379082`). Each route pin runs on the host `views` prop and on a named `listViews` entry:
  - `coverFit: 'contain'` reaches `gallery.coverFit`;
  - `cardSize` and `visibleFields` reach `gallery` the same way;
  - every key the spec declares on the block, driven off `ListViewSchema.shape.gallery`, reaches `gallery`;
  - one spelling per key: no flat `imageField` or `titleField`;
  - an undeclared title keeps the `name` floor inside the block;
  - control: an undeclared key (and a block `objectName`) reaches neither `gallery` nor the node.
- **Updated, re-spelled from flat to nested** (both pinned the flat `imageField` this card retires):
  - `ObjectView.readersRetired-6152.test.tsx`, section 3 and its header bullet;
  - `ObjectView.namedViewProtocolKeys-8980.test.tsx`, the `gallery` case.
- **Control route (`ListView`), unchanged:** plugin-list `ListView.galleryOptionsBagCanonical-6152`, `ListView.readersRetired-6152`, `ListView.test.tsx` and the twelve `ObjectGallery.*` files: 15 files, 227 tests passed.

## Reverse verification (ablation)

Predictions were written before either run. The mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` from the objectstack checkout (objectui has none), in wrap mode, with blob-equal restores. The tests import `../ObjectView` relatively, from source, and no alias or `dist/` is involved, so no rebuild was needed. Runs were on HEAD `a31f6aa85`, the fix commit.

- **A1, rebuild the flat node** (`imageField` from `coverField` plus a flat `titleField`, no nested block). Predicted: all 11 new pins red, both re-spelled pins red, the probe red on both routes. **Observed: 16 failed, 48 passed (64).** Exactly that set, and the probe readings in the table above. Mutation landed: anchor 1 to 0, blob `5fae6dbb4b45` to `abf92739b839`. Restored: blob equals HEAD (`5fae6dbb4b45`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **A2, raw spread inside the nested block** (`...viewOptions.gallery` in place of the pick). Predicted: the new control red, the round-14 gallery arm (`objectName` hijack) red, the retired-`imageField` pin red, everything else green. **Observed: 3 failed, 61 passed (64).** Exactly those three. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **`ListView`'s gallery branch (out of scope here)** still builds its nested block by spreading `schema.options?.gallery` and `schema.gallery` whole. It also writes a flat `titleField` beside `gallery.titleField`, so there are two spellings on that route. The undeclared keys it carries are inert there: `ObjectGallery` reads five keys off the block, and nested keys cannot override node keys. Observation only; there is no wrong answer at a public door. Carrier: none.
- **The `name` title floor.** Both routes floor `titleField` at the literal `'name'`, while `ObjectGallery`'s own ADR-0079 comment prefers `getRecordDisplayName` to a literal `'name'` floor. This PR keeps the floor as existing behaviour. Observation, not measured at a public door. Carrier: none.
- No committed test drives the real `ObjectGallery` through plugin-view's `ObjectView` (see the probe section for why). Carrier: none.
